svg.title: Indra's Net
svg.desc: From the image in the Avataṃsaka Sūtra: an endless net with a jewel at every knot, each jewel reflecting all the others. Every agent holds a short reflection (one-line summary) of every other agent and passes changes to its neighbours. There is no centre, and a change anywhere ripples everywhere. The planter sets up the net, then steps back.
svg.text: every jewel holds a reflection of every other
a change anywhere ripples to all · no centre
